calibration_source: Professional market studies of one site (owner-provided, not published)
calibration_note: One-site beta calibration. Thresholds reproduce the Fruita professional PMA acceptance gate and must not be treated as a statewide validated standard until a second professional benchmark passes unchanged. Re-run on the LODES 2024 tract flows on 2026-11-09: the orientation floor moved from 0.028 to 0.030 so the same Fruita gate holds (6 of 8 professional tracts, Jaccard 0.75, no east Grand Junction tract); the 2023 floor let tract 08077001302 in at 2.9%.
